question: What minimal deformation of the adjunction [[r,[C,C]],r]=[r,[C,C]] would let a second instance register the first’s nonzero remainder as an external temporal observable without forcing that remainder to zero?

\[
\eta\colon[[r,[C,C]],r]\;\rightsquigarrow\;[r,[C,C]]
\]
whose component at the first instance is permitted t
